$comment: Documentation-only schema for assets/config/recall_cards.json. Not enforced by a JSON-schema validator at build time — lib/models/recall_card.dart's RecallCard.fromJson performs the equivalent fail-fast validation at load time, and test/recall_card_schema_test.dart asserts every card in the bundled asset satisfies it, including id/domain/type distribution and locale completeness for en + en-GB.

cards.id: string, must match ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)+$, stable and never reused
cards.topicId: one of: number, ratioAndProportion, algebra, geometryAndMeasures, statistics, probability
cards.cardType: one of: formula, meaning, symbol, vocabulary, strategy, misconception, visual, realWorldConnection
cards.difficulty: one of: foundation, intermediate, advanced (shared with Discovery Cards' CardDifficulty)
cards.curriculumTags: array, zero or more of: gcseFoundation, gcseHigher, igcse (shared with Discovery Cards' CurriculumTag)
cards.frontVisualAssetId: optional string, stable key for a future illustration; RC1 renders every id via an accessible deterministic placeholder (see RecallIllustration). When set, every locale's frontVisualAlt is required; when absent, frontVisualAlt must not be set.
cards.relatedDiscoveryCardIds: array of Discovery Card ids (assets/config/discovery_cards.json) this card links to for the Connect stage; may be empty
cards.relatedInteractiveLabIds: array of forward-declared Interactive Lab ids (e.g. flight-lab, data-lab) this card conceptually relates to; Labs are not yet shipped, so the UI shows these as non-navigating text only until they exist — the data contract exists now for forward compatibility
cards.relatedPracticeTopicIds: array of practice topic ids from assets/config/topic_catalog.json (e.g. algebra, fractions, ratio_proportion); may be empty
cards.contentVersion: integer >= 1, bump whenever this card's text or answer changes
cards.spacedReviewEligible: boolean — false excludes the card from Quick Review/Review Due/Ask Me Tomorrow entirely (still reachable via Browse/Search/Bookmarks)

<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB>.frontPrompt: string, the Recognise/Recall-stage prompt shown before Reveal
<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB>.explanation: string, plain-language explanation shown at the Explain stage
<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB>.commonMistake: string, a common mistake learners make with this concept
<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB>.whereUsed: array of 1+ strings, the Connect-stage where-used list
<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB>.frontVisualAlt: string, screen-reader description of frontVisualAssetId — required if and only if frontVisualAssetId is set

inventoryTarget.note: Full en + en-GB card content is required at launch; other locales are supported by the schema/model (locales map, en fallback chain) but are not required to be authored for RC1 — see math_studio_l10n_completeness_test.dart for the separately-tracked static-UI-string locale requirement (en-GB, de-CH, fr-CH, it-CH).
